text:
Predicates:
Flies(x, y) ::: x flies to airport y.
SameAirport(x, y) ::: x's departure and arrival airports are the same.
Airport(y) ::: y is an airport.
Premises:
Susan flies to LGA airport ::: Flies(Susan, LGA).
Departure and arrival cannot be the same airport ::: ¬SameAirport(Susan, LGA).
John flies from LGA airport ::: Flies(John, LGA).
Conclusion:
Flies(Susan, LGA) ::: Susan flies from LGA airport.
